title: Solar Position Algorithm for Solar Radiation Applications
version: NREL/TP-560-34302, revised January 2008; C tester updated by NLR
publisher: National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly NREL)

license.name: NLR SPA internal noncommercial software notice

units.pressure: millibar in the NLR input contract

measurement_uncertainty.description: The publisher claims approximately plus or minus 0.0003 degree algorithm uncertainty for zenith and azimuth over years -2000 to 6000.

known_gaps: The C implementation was not downloaded because it requires form submission and acceptance of non-redistribution terms.
The publisher states that the software is not guaranteed across platforms.
NexusEP uses pvlib's independent Python SPA implementation; the NLR source remains local-only corroborating material.

preprocessing.description: Check the locally held header and tester for the declared inputs and published scalar reference outputs without redistributing source or derived fixtures.

permitted_use.purpose: Internal, noncommercial analytical verification of solar position
permitted_use.notes: Do not commit or redistribute the NLR SPA source. The notice must remain accessible to application users when the software itself is used.
